Bill.BriefDescription: Providing medical coverage for smoking cessation programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing medical coverage for smoking cessationprograms; and adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall provide coverage under this chapter forsmoking cessation counseling services, as well as prescription andnonprescription agents when used to promote smoking cessation, so longas such agents otherwise meet the definition of "covered outpatientdrug" in 42 U.S.C. Sec. 1396r8(k). No prior authorization is requiredfor coverage of counseling services or smoking cessation medications.However, the department may initiate an individualized inquiry anddetermine and implement by rule appropriate coverage limitations as maybe required to discourage waste or address instances of fraud or abuseby a person receiving services under this chapter.
